events.whyItMatters: A BASF takeover of Evonik would be the biggest consolidation in German chemicals in years, and RAG-Stiftung's roughly 43.8% stake -- not Evonik's board, which says there are no talks -- decides whether it happens.

phases.headline: BASF Made Merger Proposal to German Rival Evonik, FT Reports
phases.priceReaction: Evonik up as much as 11% intraday, closed +7.2%; BASF down as much as 3.4%

phases.headline: Germany's Evonik rejects BASF's $11.7 billion bid, sources say
phases.priceReaction: Evonik +2.4% to EUR19.84; BASF little changed after a 3.6% fall on Friday

phases.headline: BASF erwägt besseres Angebot für Evonik - Insider
BASF raises Evonik offer to €24 a share, sources say
phases.priceReaction: Evonik +2.7% at close (up as much as 5.2% intraday)

phases.headline: Evonik Leaves Opening After Turning Down BASF Takeover Talks

events.counterparty: Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena (BMPS.MI)
events.whyItMatters: MPS shareholders, led by Delfin and Caltagirone, voted down CEO Lovaglio's all-share bids for Banco BPM and Banca Generali and the Mediobanca merger, opening the way for Intesa's sweetened offer. With ECB authorisation in hand and Consob now approving the offer document, the acceptance period runs from 24 November 2026 to 22 January 2027; Italy's antitrust authority, which may demand branch sales, is the last visible hurdle to creating the eurozone's second-largest bank by market value.

phases.headline: Italy's Intesa raises MPS takeover offer price and warns it could drop bid
Intesa Says Its Paschi Bid Backed by Top Shareholder Delfin
Monte dei Paschi says Intesa's raised offer still too low
phases.priceReaction: MPS and Intesa shares up about 1% in early trading the next day

phases.headline: Italy's Intesa gets ECB authorisation to take over Monte dei Paschi
Monte Paschi Investors Reject Banco BPM Bid in Win For Intesa
MPS: Consob gives the go-ahead for Intesa's offer; launch on 24 November

events.whyItMatters: EU clearance for Kimberly-Clark's ~$49bn Kenvue takeover costs only its EEA feminine-care brands (to Dilek Grup), leaving China's in-depth review as the main hurdle before the consumer-health combination can close.

phases.headline: Kimberly-Clark gets conditional EU approval for Kenvue acquisition
Kimberly-Clark's $40B purchase of Kenvue wins China antitrust approval
Kimberly-Clark (KMB) Completes Kenvue Acquisition, Unveils $3.1 Billion Integration Program

events.whyItMatters: LSEG confirmed talks to pay about $3.5bn for Permira-owned credit-data firm Octus, a bolt-on it says would be immediately accretive to Data & Analytics growth — but investors sold the shares on the price and financing question.

phases.headline: LSEG in Talks to Buy Permira-Owned Credit Firm Octus
LSEG Seals $3.5 Billion Octus Deal as Group Fights Back AI Fears

events.whyItMatters: International Seaways has closed its ~$370m, ~96%-stock purchase of Oslo-listed Bruton and its four VLCC newbuildings, adding very-large-crude-carrier exposure to its crude and product fleet in paper rather than cash; holders now own a bigger VLCC book and carry roughly 3m new shares of dilution.

phases.headline: International Seaways Announces Agreements to Acquire Bruton Limited
International Seaways completes acquisition of Bruton Limited (Form 8-K: Completion of Acquisition or Disposition of Assets)

events.whyItMatters: CRH's biggest-ever deal closes months ahead of the Q1 2027 target, adding a 109-site US aggregates platform plus grid-transmission structures and $175m of targeted synergies; updated 2026 guidance lands with Q3 results on 29 October.

phases.headline: CRH Completes Acquisition of Arcosa

events.whyItMatters: DoorDash's agreed $65-a-share, mostly cash purchase of Instacart (about $17bn, 26% above the pre-leak price) combines the top US restaurant and grocery delivery apps to take on Walmart and Amazon, but closing is not expected before late 2027 and the deal faces heavy antitrust scrutiny, backed by a $1.25bn break fee DoorDash owes if it fails.

phases.headline: Instacart in talks with DoorDash and Uber for sale, The Information reports
DoorDash in talks to buy Instacart in roughly $17 billion deal, source says
DoorDash to acquire Instacart in deal valued around $17B, companies announce

events.whyItMatters: A $7.5-8bn bid for the US forecourt operator would be Couche-Tard's second big deal since July's Żabka stake, adding US scale but more leverage; it comes in below Cumberland Farms' $9bn IPO target, so TDR Capital and the Issa brothers may hold out for the float.

phases.headline: Couche-Tard proposes up to $8 billion offer for Cumberland Farms, The Times reports

events.whyItMatters: An all-stock merger at 0.987 EQT shares per Range share creates the largest vertically integrated US natural gas producer (>$50bn pro forma EV), with Range holders taking ~27%, a big bet on Appalachian gas demand from LNG and data centres.

phases.headline: EQT to acquire Range Resources in all-stock deal valued at more than $50 billion

events.whyItMatters: Ovintiv adds ~266,000 net Montney oil-window acres and ~20 MBOE/d for about US$890m (C$1.26bn incl. debt) in cash, its second Montney deal of 2026 after NuVista, while saying its ≥60%-of-FCF shareholder-return target is unchanged.

phases.headline: Logan Energy Corp. Announces Agreement To Be Acquired By Ovintiv Inc., For $1.40 Per Share In Cash And The Spin-out Of Logan Oil Corp.

events.whyItMatters: Challenger's ~20% top shareholder wants the rest at A$11.80 (~A$7.9bn); the board rejected that price but will keep engaging, so the stock now trades on whether Dai-ichi lifts its bid toward the A$12.50-13 analysts suggest.

phases.headline: Australia's Challenger gets takeover bid from unit of Japan's Dai-ichi Life
phases.priceReaction: rose to A$11.41, an eight-year high

phases.headline: Challenger board rejects TAL Daiichi Life's takeover bid
phases.priceReaction: shares tracking lower on the ASX

events.whyItMatters: AVID (backed by Mubadala and Brookfield) holds exclusivity at A$5.45 a security, but Warburg Pincus has topped it at A$5.55 and Ingenia has given AVID until 10 November to match; both bids require Ingenia to scrap its Peet deal, so the auction sets both price and strategy.

phases.headline: Ingenia Soars on Fresh $1.6 Billion Takeover Bid From AVID
AVID matches Warburg's Ingenia Communities bid and shuts out rival for now
Ingenia Communities Receives Updated $5.55 Warburg Pincus Offer, Initiates AVID Matching Rights Process

events.whyItMatters: Tata settled its €14.40-a-share cash offer on 30 October, taking about 89% of Iveco for roughly €3.4bn and installing a new board, so Iveco is now a Tata-controlled European truck maker heading for delisting via squeeze-out or the shareholder-approved demerger-and-liquidation route.

phases.headline: Tata Motors' Iveco bid crosses 80% threshold as acceptances hit 87.81%
Tata Motors secures control of Iveco Group, new board takes office

events.whyItMatters: Simpson replaced a $200m buyback with an open-ended $1.0bn authorization, roughly five times larger and a big slice of its market cap, a signal that management sees surplus cash and an undervalued share price.

phases.headline: Simpson Manufacturing approves $1 billion buyback program

events.whyItMatters: HealthSpan (Bon Secours) has lifted its cash price to $25.00 (up to $26.61 with ticking fees if closing slips past 1 March 2027) after an unsolicited rival bid that rose to $28; the board judged that bid not superior on regulatory risk and timing, so holders now weigh a firmer signed floor against a higher but less certain alternative while Bain rolls its ~38.5% stake.

phases.headline: Surgery Partners to Be Acquired by Bon Secours for $5.7 Billion
Deal fever drove a big day for Surgery Partners

events.whyItMatters: The largest US BDC is absorbing Apollo's listed BDC for about $10.88 a share in stock and cash (a 30% premium), adding ~$2.6bn of assets and signalling consolidation among sub-scale private-credit vehicles trading below book.

phases.headline: Ares Capital Corporation (ARCC) Reports Strong Q3 Results and Announces MidCap Acquisition

events.whyItMatters: A $9bn cash-and-debt buy of a high-voltage grid equipment maker deepens GE Vernova's Electrification bet on AI-driven grid demand, but trades buyback firepower for a deal that only closes in late 2027.

phases.headline: GE Vernova Agrees to Pay $9 Billion to Acquire Trench Group

events.counterparty: Trian Fund Management (with Flynn Group, BlueFive Capital, Sixth Street)
events.whyItMatters: Wendy's independent committee rejected the $7.35 cash bid from its ~16% holder Trian as undervaluing its 'Dave's Way' plan and adopted a one-year 15% poison pill, so the bid floor is gone unless Trian raises its price or turns hostile.

phases.headline: Wendy's Receives $1.4 Billion Buyout Offer From Peltz's Trian
Wendy's Rejects Takeover Bid From Trian to Take It Private

events.whyItMatters: The largest quantum-computing acquisition to date (~$2.3bn cash and stock) adds algorithm-synthesis software to Intel's spin-qubit hardware, a full-stack quantum bet made while its core foundry turnaround still needs capital.

phases.headline: Intel to acquire Israeli quantum startup Classiq for $2.3 billion in record deal

events.whyItMatters: A $10-a-share all-cash buyout, a 46% premium valuing ADT at $15.3bn including debt and financed by Apollo-managed funds, sets a floor for the stock, while a go-shop to 28 November leaves room for a higher bid.

phases.headline: Thrive Holdings to acquire ADT for $7.6 billion in cash deal

events.whyItMatters: Marvell has signed to buy Lumentum for 4.5 of its shares each, a $115bn enterprise value and a ~24% premium, bringing the lasers behind AI optical interconnects in-house; Lumentum holders end up with ~33% of the combined company, and with closing not expected until the first half of 2028, Marvell owners carry heavy dilution and a long regulatory wait against a promised $1bn+ of cost synergies.

phases.headline: Marvell Is Said to Near Deal for Lumentum In AI-Related Megadeal
Marvell to buy Lumentum in $115 billion deal in AI data-center bet

events.whyItMatters: Ahold Delhaize's roughly €1.7bn purchase of Tesco's 360-plus Czech and Slovak stores would make its Albert chain Czechia's grocery market leader and open Slovakia as a new market, while Tesco retreats further toward its UK and Irish core.

phases.headline: Ahold Delhaize announces the acquisition of Tesco Czechia and Slovakia, strengthening its position in Europe

events.whyItMatters: Guidewire is paying $1.7bn in cash, plus up to $400m in earnouts, for hyperexponential's AI pricing and underwriting platform, its biggest move to extend its P&C core-systems franchise into underwriting before AI-native rivals take that ground.

phases.headline: Guidewire Signs Definitive Agreement to Acquire hyperexponential

events.whyItMatters: Viatris's $36.50-a-share cash offer (about $1.65bn, a roughly 45% premium) gives Pacira holders a clean exit and moves Viatris beyond generics into branded non-opioid pain care, funded mostly from cash on hand.

phases.headline: Viatris to buy pain therapy maker Pacira BioSciences for $1.65 billion
Viatris Announces Commencement of Tender Offer to Acquire Pacira BioSciences, Inc.

events.whyItMatters: An all-cash $11.70-a-share exit at a 34.5% premium (about $420m) caps Perion's upside unless the go-shop to 11 December draws a higher bid, and takes the ad-tech name off Nasdaq and TASE.

phases.headline: Perion Enters into Definitive Merger Agreement with Affle

events.whyItMatters: Monomoy's unsolicited $101-a-share cash proposal puts a private-equity price on LCI while its all-stock merger with Patrick Industries awaits an 18 November vote; the board says the bid is not superior and points to a standalone DCF above $150, so holders now weigh certain cash against synergy-dependent paper in the combined company.

phases.headline: Monomoy Capital Makes Unsolicited Bid for LCI Industries Amid Patrick Merger
LCI rejects unsolicited acquisition bid, affirms support for Patrick merger

events.whyItMatters: A ~$4.2bn purchase of Marathon's St. Paul Park and Mandan refineries plus marketing business nearly doubles CVR's refining capacity and, on CVR's figures, more than doubles its EBITDA base, funded with new equity (incl. Trafigura) and $2.5bn of secured debt.

phases.headline: CVR Energy Announces Transformative Transaction to Acquire 2 Refineries and Marketing Platform From Marathon Petroleum

events.whyItMatters: A reported ¥1.3tn+ (~$8.2bn) purchase of chip-materials maker JSR from state fund JIC would be transformational for Mitsui Chemicals, pivoting it toward semiconductor photoresists at the cost of a much larger balance sheet.

phases.headline: Mitsui Chemicals to buy Japan chip material maker JSR for over $8.2bn
Mitsui Chemicals to buy chip materials firm JSR for $11.6 billion

events.whyItMatters: Combines a solar tracker maker with an electrical balance-of-system supplier in an all-stock deal that hands Shoals holders ~65% of the merged company, betting scale and cross-selling can offset tariff and pricing pressure in US utility-scale solar.

phases.headline: ARRAY to buy Shoals in $1.32 billion all-stock deal

events.counterparty: Harvestone Low Carbon Partners (Energy Capital Partners)
events.whyItMatters: Adds three carbon-capture-equipped ethanol plants and lifts renewables capacity 40%+ to ~730m gallons, with roughly half the $915m price resting on 45Z/45Q tax-credit cash flows, so the return now hinges on US clean-fuel credit policy.

phases.headline: Andersons to acquire ethanol producer HLCP for $915 million

events.counterparty: Empower Brands (Spectrum Brands SPB and Oaktree)
events.whyItMatters: A public $37-a-share cash bid (~$1.6bn EV) after private approaches were rebuffed puts a floor under the tariff-hit stock and pressures a board that has unanimously rejected it as opportunistic.

phases.headline: Helen of Troy jumps after Spectrum Brands makes takeover offer

events.whyItMatters: Adani Ports' first European foothold costs €2.56bn EV (€1.18bn equity, 11.7x 2025 EBITDA) for Europe's second-largest liquid-storage operator, eight terminals with 6.3m cbm across five countries; it is debt-funded, taking pro forma net debt to ~2.8x EBITDA, with completion up to 15 months away.

phases.headline: Adani Ports to Buy Europe's Evos in $2.9 Billion Deal

events.whyItMatters: A new open-ended $25bn repurchase authorization, on top of the remaining balance and far above the ~$3.9bn Lam bought back in fiscal 2026, signals management expects the AI-driven wafer-fab equipment cycle to keep throwing off surplus cash.

phases.headline: Lam Research approves $25B buyback, $0.33 quarterly dividend

events.whyItMatters: EVgo's ~56% controlling holder wants to buy out public shareholders at $2.00 cash (59% premium), so the special committee's response now sets the floor for minority value and a likely Nasdaq delisting.

phases.headline: EVgo Confirms Receipt of Unsolicited and Non-Binding Take-Private Proposal

events.whyItMatters: Fox now owns the largest US TV-streaming platform, shifting its mix from linear broadcast toward digital advertising, with ~$400m of targeted cost savings and former Roku holders owning ~26% of the enlarged company.

phases.headline: Fox Completes $22 Billion Roku Acquisition

events.whyItMatters: CNH is selling 70% of its sub-scale construction equipment arm (CASE, New Holland Construction) for $700m cash at a $1bn EV and keeping 30%, turning itself into a near pure-play agriculture equipment and precision-tech company.

phases.headline: CNH Announces Agreement to Form a Joint Venture by Selling a 70% Interest in its Construction Equipment Business to Kobelco Construction Machinery

events.counterparty: Silver Lake and Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund (PIF)
events.whyItMatters: The Electronic Arts buyers are in preliminary talks to take Unity private at about $25bn, above its ~$21.5bn market value, and Unity has hired a bank to weigh options, putting a sponsor price floor under a stock that already holds Silver Lake as an ~8% owner.

phases.headline: Unity shares jump on report of takeover interest from Silver Lake, PIF

events.whyItMatters: Crédit Agricole wants to fold its Italian bank and insurance arms into Banco BPM at an exchange ratio pricing BPM 20% above its own contribution, plus a €1bn special dividend, lifting its stake to ~45% without a mandatory bid; it would create Italy's third-largest bank with €800m of targeted synergies, but needs a two-thirds EGM vote and a whitewash of minority holders, and would close only in H2 2027.

phases.headline: Crédit Agricole proposes to Banco BPM to create together a new leading Italian bank
phases.priceReaction: Banco BPM up as much as 12% intraday

events.whyItMatters: CVC and GBL's €53-a-share offer has reportedly reached 91.93% of Recordati after the reopening, clearing the 90% threshold for a squeeze-out, so the remaining float is headed for a forced buy-out and delisting from Euronext Milan rather than a merger vote.

phases.headline: Recordati: l'Opa sale al 91,93%, titolo va verso il delisting

events.whyItMatters: Strathcona adds Greenfire's oil sands SAGD assets for ~C$2.7-2.9bn including debt with ~C$75m of targeted synergies, while common controller Waterous Energy Fund backs the deal and lifts its Strathcona stake to ~60-64%.

phases.headline: Strathcona to Acquire Greenfire in Canadian Oil Sands Deal

events.whyItMatters: CVS will spin its ~9,000-store retail pharmacy into a separate listed company by 1H 2028, leaving CVS Health as an Aetna-plus-Caremark payer/PBM story and unwinding two decades of vertical integration.

phases.headline: CVS Health to Split Retail Pharmacy from Aetna, Caremark by 2028
